args.body: Use pr43-placement-evidence.json if committed and read the relevant changes in the captured patch. Under valid SQLITE-COMMUNITY-DIRECTORY-FIT ownership, compare what actually merged with the draft diagnostic entry. If placement and contribution eligibility are supported, prepare the private one-line README diff and operator handoff from the existing draft. Cite the paired reports for any worked result. If a material eligibility question remains, give the exact unresolved question and the evidence needed to settle it. Read back the final artifact and close with a lesson. No external submission.

description: The directory’s README invites pull requests, and the host retrieved the patch for a recorded merge. The patch can show whether that merge added a comparable listing. A private referral handoff can advance on that evidence, while submission requires an authorized operator and any later public deployment requires independent review. Treasury is unfunded with CAD 0 available and CAD 0 verified revenue. Five feedback sources remain unclassified, so demand is unknown.
